title: The bode plot cannot be left over SCPI
fact: BPL:ENAB OFF (and 0) gives -221 Settings conflict and BPL:ENAB? stays 1: after a sweep, with AUX OUT off, generator off, results reset, input and output on different channels, and right after BPL:ENAB ON with defaults. *RST leaves it. Sweeps work: 41 points 100 Hz..1 MHz in 6 s, BPL:FREQ/GAIN/PHAS:DATA? read (ASCII format).
consequence: Leaving the bode plot resets every scope setting.
where: not in the driver: bode removed 2026-10-16 (operator: not needed)
evidence: session 2026-10-16 08:3x; original repository records/*_scope3_bode; original repository measurements/*_verify_scope3_bode.md
review: 2026-10-16: the operator reported broken bode SCPI. Command-level retest worked; the bode driver run then found BPL:ENAB OFF refused in every state tried. Quirk.

title: Default channel type is high resolution
fact: After our setup the channel type reads HRES and ACQ:HRES AUTO: an averaged decimation that low-passes the trace; roll mode is automatic.
consequence: Noise and edges measure low without a sign.
where: Acquire.apply sets every acquisition setting and reads it back
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced: after *RST CHAN1:TYPE? reads SAMP (UM default). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Record length written before the timebase is ignored
fact: ACQ:POIN written before TIM:SCAL is lost; write it after.
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced: ACQ:POIN before TIM:SCAL kept 10000. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: The record covers 12 divisions and more; DMAX only when stopped
fact: The screen is 12 divisions; TIM:RAT? can exceed it (16 ms at 1 ms/div). DATA:POIN DMAX returns the screen range at the ADC rate, only while stopped; while running DEF applies. ACQ:SRAT? differs from the transferred rate (ACQ:POIN:ARAT?).
consequence: Point counts and sample rate depend on the run state.
where: capture_traces reads after a single acquisition; time axis from the header
review: 2026-10-16: desk: UM p.540 states DMAX only while stopped. Retest inconclusive (0 points both ways). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: An interrupted wait leaves -410
fact: A *OPC? that times out after SING leaves -410 Query INTERRUPTED in the error queue.
consequence: The next error check reports a stale error.
where: wait_acquisition clears the queue after a timeout and raises TriggerError
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced: *OPC? after SING returned, no -410. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: A hidden no-trigger state, cleared by autoset
fact: 2026-10-15 12:0x: the A edge trigger on CH1 did not fire on a 1 Vpp 10 kHz sine at every level, mode and timebase tried, with every queried trigger, channel and acquisition setting normal. AUToscale cleared it; the same driver steps afterwards fired every time. Not reproduced.
consequence: A capture can time out with correct settings.
where: RTB2000.wait_acquisition docstring: TriggerError names the source and mode; if settings are correct, autoset restores triggering

title: Time reference has three positions
fact: TIM:REF takes 8.33 %, 50 % or 91.67 % (one division from the left, centre, one division from the right); other values snap to the nearest and some queue -222 Data out of range.
consequence: A percent reference does not apply as written.

title: Record length applies at the next acquisition
fact: ACQ:POIN is accepted at once (no error, *OPC? returns) but ACQ:POIN? reads the old value until the next acquisition completes; with no acquisition running (stopped, or normal trigger without a signal) it stays old.
consequence: An immediate read-back reports a failure that is only a delay; earlier probes misread this as lost writes.
where: Acquire.set_record_length starts RUN and polls the read-back
review: 2026-10-16: retested: ACQ:POIN? keeps the old value until the next acquisition; a design choice. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Statistics need measurement slot 1
fact: MEAS<m>:STAT ON (the suffix is irrelevant: statistics apply to all active measurements) gives -221 Settings conflict unless slot 1 is on; with slot 1 on it applies.
consequence: Statistics on another slot alone fail.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: MEAS2:STAT ON gives -221 unless slot 1 is on; UM p.388 says the suffix is irrelevant. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Fast segmentation misses triggers; queries while running miss more
fact: awg 3-cycle burst every 10 ms, 50 us/div, record 10 k, fast segmentation on: 89 of 100 bursts stored in 1 s with no queries, 57 with an ACQ:AVA? query every 0.1 s; at 1 ms bursts 120 per s (on) and 270 per s (off). Timestamps are exact (gaps are whole multiples of the burst period). Record length minimum 10 k (1 k gives -222).
consequence: History does not hold every trigger at high rates; do not poll fast while acquiring.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: fast segmentation capture rate figure.

title: *RST keeps the Aux Out mode
fact: After *RST, TRIG:OUT:MODE? still reads REF: the 10 MHz reference output survives a reset while every channel and timebase setting returns to its default.
consequence: A reset does not drop the awg reference lock.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: after *RST TRIG:OUT:MODE? reads REF; UM p.465 gives *RST OFF. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Threshold find level is not the 50 % point
fact: CHANnel:THReshold:FINDlevel on a -0.01 to 0.98 V square set 0.586 V (60 %) and 0.510 V (53 %) in two runs; it uses the screen, so a channel ranged for another signal gives a wrong level (0.256 V at 0.2 V/div, offset 0).
consequence: The found threshold is not the 50 % point.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: FINDlevel 0.26 V on a 0..1 V square; the level uses the screen; no stated 50 % rule. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: FFT frequency range follows the time record
fact: SPEC:FREQ:STOP 100000 with a 1.2 ms record gives -222 Data out of range; the scope keeps 0 to 2.86 MHz, RBW 14.3 kHz (8192 points). Span and RBW follow the timebase and record length.
consequence: A requested span applies only when the record allows it.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: FFT stop beyond the record range gives -222; span follows the record (design). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Waveform export while stopped fails
fact: EXP:WAV:SAVE after STOP gave -200 Execution error and -410 Query INTERRUPTED; while running it writes the CSV (3.4 MB for 125 k points).
review: 2026-10-16: retest differs: EXP:WAV:SAVE gave -200 both stopped and running; cause not found. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md

title: Detail queries on an invalid frame time out
fact: BUS1:I2C:FRAM1:ADDR?, ADEV?, AMOD?, DATA? on a frame with state UNEX give -200 and no reply (the query hangs to timeout); BYTE1:VAL? gives -114. LIN FRAM:CSV? timed out once on a valid frame. I2C ADDR? returns the 8-bit form (0x50 write reads 160).
consequence: A naive frame readout stalls on every invalid frame.
where: Bus.get_frames: detail fields only for state ok, 1.5 s limit per query, queue cleared
review: 2026-10-16: not retested (needs an invalid frame on demand); a query without reply is a fault.

title: UART pattern trigger takes bits in wire order; some trigger headers refused
fact: TRIG:A:UART:PATT is matched LSB first (wire order): 'E' (0x45) fires as "10100010", not "01000101". TRIG:A:SOUR:UART RX gives -113. The waveform-save action refuses its destination: TRIG:EVEN:WFMS:DEST "/INT/USEREV" gives -256, "/INT" gives -200.
consequence: An MSB-first pattern never fires; the waveform-file action is not usable remotely.
where: Trigger.apply_bus_uart reverses each symbol; writes the UART source only for TX; Trigger.apply_actions docstring
review: 2026-10-16: retested: TRIG:A:SOUR:UART RX -113 (documented header). Wire-order matching is an observation; the WFMS destination gave -256 for a missing folder. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-00-45_review_quirks_scope.md
